blocker_rule: Every blocker carries a durable owner: "thread:<name>", or a list of them for joint ownership, where <name> is listed in owner_registry. Free text ('this thread', a lane, a description) is not an owner and scores blocker_owner:<id>; role notes go in owner_note. A blocker is CLOSED only with checked proof {commit, artifact, after_metric}: commit must resolve as a commit in this repo (git cat-file -e <sha>^{commit}; git unavailable fails closed); artifact must be a repo-relative regular file inside the repo after resolving symlinks (no absolute path, no '..', no directory); after_metric must be {"metric": <name>, "before": <finite number>, "after": <finite number>} (bools, NaN, bare strings or bare numbers are rejected). A CLOSED without valid proof scores as OPEN (INVALID_CLOSE). A gap listed in tracked_gaps must stay declared as a blocker (by its gap id) on each named requirement until it is closed with proof; removing the line does not turn the requirement green. cross_cutting_blockers apply to every requirement in this specification.
